description:
*“I’m getting married.”*

With the sudden marriage announcement from his ten-year friend Ye-geon, Hyeonwu’s long, unrequited love—which he had never once let show—comes to an abrupt end.
While trying to sort through his complicated feelings, Hyeonwu drinks heavily at Ye-geon’s wedding afterparty. The next day, he wakes up shocked to find Hee-geon half-naked in his house.

Hee-geon explains that he simply brought the heavily intoxicated Hyeonwu home safely out of family courtesy as part of the groom's party. Yet even after that night, Hee-geon keeps texting him at every opportunity, popping up out of nowhere, and continuously lingering in Hyeonwu’s life.
Because of this, an unexpected variation breaks into Hyeonwu’s monotonous, treadmill-like daily routine, and he gradually finds his mind drifting toward Hee-geon.
